items.headline: Kittle on the PUP list after the Achilles; Week 1 is not guaranteed
items.summary: George Kittle was placed on the PUP list while recovering from the torn Achilles suffered in the 2025 playoffs. He has said he wants to play Week 1, but there is no guarantee he comes off PUP in time. Jake Tonges and Luke Farrell would split tight end.

items.headline: Monangai (hyperextended knee) doubtful for Week 1; Swift gains volume
items.summary: Kyle Monangai hyperextended his knee in practice and is expected to miss multiple weeks, putting his Week 1 availability in doubt. If he misses regular-season games, D'Andre Swift takes on a larger role in the Chicago backfield.

items.headline: Jayden Higgins out for the 2026 season with a torn ACL
items.summary: Texans receiver Jayden Higgins was ruled out for the entire 2026 season with a torn ACL. He should not occupy a roster spot in any draft.

items.headline: Nabers practising without a non-contact jersey, on track for Week 1
items.summary: Malik Nabers was seen at practice without the non-contact jersey and was a limited participant in 11-on-11 work. He appears on track to play Week 1.

items.headline: Rams: Kyren Williams starts every week, Corum alternates drives
items.summary: Kyren Williams starts every week for the Rams and Blake Corum takes the entire second drive, with the two alternating drives for the rest of the game outside obvious passing situations. This is a drive split, not a replacement.

items.headline: New England: Stevenson is the clear RB1; Henderson mixes in sparingly at first
items.summary: Training camp reports have Rhamondre Stevenson entrenched as the starter in New England. TreVeyon Henderson will mix in sparingly, at least to start the year.

items.headline: Cutdown day: Josh Jacobs and Jaydon Blue among the moves with fantasy impact
items.summary: The 2026 roster cutdown day produced moves with direct fantasy readings around Josh Jacobs and Jaydon Blue. Check the current status of both before spending a pick, because their team context may have changed since preseason rankings were published.

items.headline: Warren has an adductor strain; Week 1 does not look in serious jeopardy
items.summary: Colts tight end Tyler Warren suffered an adductor strain and could be back as soon as next week. This does not sound like an injury that puts Week 1 in serious jeopardy.

items.headline: Hubbard week-to-week with a hamstring issue
items.summary: Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard is dealing with a hamstring issue and is listed as week-to-week.

items.headline: Jacksonville splits the backfield after Etienne's move to New Orleans
items.summary: With Travis Etienne Jr. now in New Orleans, Bhayshul Tuten is the name fantasy drafters are chasing in Jacksonville. Chris Rodriguez Jr. signed a two-year, $10 million deal and his 5-foot-11, 225-pound frame points to early-down and red-zone work.

items.headline: Denver's backfield is crowded: Harvey, Dobbins and rookie Coleman
items.summary: The Denver backfield is crowded, with rookie Jonah Coleman joining RJ Harvey and the injury-prone J.K. Dobbins. It is one of the committees flagged to avoid in 2026.

items.headline: Washington splits three ways: Croskey-Merritt, White as the receiver, rookie Allen
items.summary: Jacory Croskey-Merritt is back for his second season after a quiet but fairly productive rookie campaign. Rachaad White is the most competent pass-catcher in the backfield, and rookie Kaytron Allen, Penn State's all-time leading rusher, was a sixth-round pick in the 2026 draft.

items.headline: Mahomes (knee) on track to start Week 1 against Denver
items.summary: Patrick Mahomes is recovering from a knee injury and is on track to start in Week 1 against Denver.

items.headline: Daniel Jones back from the Achilles with no known Week 1 doubt
items.summary: Daniel Jones returns from an Achilles injury and there are no reports casting doubt on his Week 1 availability, though his profile remains that of a streaming quarterback in shallow leagues.
